paper_title: Search for light scalar Dark Matter candidate with AURIGA detector
notes: AURIGA resonant-mass detector searches for moduli scalar DM coupling to photons (d_e) and electron mass (d_me); same limit applies to both. Pre-analysis hint ScalarPhoton (d_e) matches the photon/alpha coupling. The paper reports d_e <~ 1e-5 around m_phi=3.6e-12 eV in the band 850-950 Hz (mass 3.52e-12 to 3.93e-12 eV using m=4.136e-15*f). Exact per-mass values from Fig.5 not tabulated; data points are approximate from text.
